title: Modul HRD - Recruitment (Perekrutan) - Panduan Lengkap
description: Panduan lengkap menggunakan Modul Recruitment dalam sistem HRD GIMS mencakup job posting, aplikasi screening, interview process, offer management, onboarding, dan employee data creation.
author: Tim GIMS

content.body: Modul Recruitment mengelola seluruh proses perekrutan talenta mulai dari job posting, penerimaan aplikasi, screening, interview (multi-round), offer letter, hingga onboarding dan creation employee record. Modul ini terintegrasi dengan Employee untuk master data karyawan baru, Payroll untuk setup gaji, dan HRD lainnya untuk seamless integration.

items.title: Job Posting
items.body: Buat & publish job vacancy dengan deskripsi role, requirements, salary range ke portal karir

items.title: Aplikasi Management
items.body: Terima & kelola aplikasi dari candidates, track status aplikasi (applied, screened, invited, dll)

items.title: Screening Process
items.body: Review CV, scoring, shortlist candidate untuk interview berdasarkan qualification

items.title: Interview Management
items.body: Schedule multi-round interview (HR, Technical, Final), track feedback & scoring

items.title: Offer & Negotiation
items.body: Generate offer letter, manage salary negotiation, send offer ke candidate

items.title: Onboarding
items.body: Koordinasikan onboarding process & transition dari hiring ke active employee record

items.title: Job Posting (Membuka Vacancy)
items.body:
Job Posting adalah proses membuat & publish lowongan pekerjaan ke career portal & media sosial sehingga calon karyawan dapat apply.

---

ALUR RECRUITMENT FLOW:

1. Business Request (Manager)
   - Manager request ke HR: "Kami butuh 2 Senior Developer"
   - Alasan: Project baru, resign karyawan lama, expansion
   - Timeline: Butuh orang mulai Mei 2026

2. Approval (HR Manager)
   - HR review: Budgeted? Needed? Right timing?
   - Approve jika OK, atau discuss alternative
   - Once approved: Create job posting

3. Job Posting (HR)
   - Create vacancy di system
   - Publish ke career portal & job boards
   - Promote via social media, referral
   - Collect & manage applications

4. Screening
   - HR review CVs
   - Shortlist qualified candidates
   - Invite untuk interview

5. Interview
   - HR Screen interview
   - Technical interview (with team)
   - Final interview (with manager/director)

6. Offer
   - Make decision (approve/reject)
   - Send offer letter ke selected candidate
   - Negotiate salary jika perlu
   - Candidate sign offer → acceptance

7. Onboarding
   - Prepare office/equipment
   - Setup IT access, email, systems
   - Welcome program
   - Create employee record

---

CARA CREATE JOB POSTING (HR):

1. Buka Recruitment → Job Postings
2. Klik + Create New Job Posting
3. Isi informasi:
   
   Job Details:
   - Job Title: "Senior Developer (Java/Spring Boot)"
   - Department: IT/Engineering
   - Reports To: Head of Engineering
   - Job Type: Full-time / Contract / Intern
   - Employment Type: Permanent / Fixed-term (1 year, 2 year, etc)
   - Location: Jakarta / Remote / Hybrid
   - Salary Range: Rp 15-20 juta/month (atau "Negotiable")
   - Number of Positions: 2 (berapa orang direkrut)
   
   Job Description:
   - "We're looking for experienced Java developer to lead technical projects..."
   - List main responsibilities (5-7 bullets)
   - List required qualifications
   - Nice-to-have skills
   
   Qualifications:
   - Required:
     * Bachelor's degree (Computer Science or related)
     * 5+ years Java development experience
     * Spring Boot, Microservices architecture
     * REST API design & development
     * PostgreSQL database
   
   - Nice-to-have:
     * AWS cloud experience
     * Docker/Kubernetes
     * CI/CD pipeline
     * Leadership/mentoring experience
   
   Publishing:
   - Publish Date: 15/04/2026
   - Deadline: 30/05/2026 (application close date)
   - Visibility: Public (show on career portal)
   - Channels: Career portal, LinkedIn, job boards (select)

4. Klik Publish
5. Status: PUBLISHED (mulai terima aplikasi)
6. Job posting live di portal

---

JOB POSTING BEST PRACTICES:

✓ Title clear & specific ("Senior Developer Java" bukan "Software Engineer")
✓ Description konkret (what they'll do)
✓ Requirements realistic (jangan terlalu high bar)
✓ Salary range disclosed (transparency, attract better candidates)
✓ Location flexible (remote option if possible)
✓ Close date clear (sense of urgency)
✓ About company (culture, vision, benefits)
✓ Application process explained (what to expect)

---

APPLICATION PORTAL:

Candidate akses career portal:
1. Browse available jobs
2. Click job → read full description
3. Click "Apply Now"
4. Submit:
   - Resume/CV
   - Cover letter
   - Contact info (email, phone)
   - Availability
   - Salary expectation (optional)
5. Confirmation: "Thank you, we'll review and contact you"

---

SYSTEM NOTIFICATIONS:

When candidate apply:
- HR notified: New application received
- Email to HR: "[Candidate Name] applied for Senior Developer"
- Application tracked in system: status = APPLIED
- Candidate get auto-response: "Thank you for applying. We'll review..."

---

MANAGE POSTINGS:

HR dapat:
- Monitor applications real-time (dashboard)
- Extend deadline jika aplikasi kurang
- Close posting early jika sudah cukup
- Edit job details (jika ada update)
- Archive posting (untuk reference)
- Reuse posting (next cycle year)

items.title: Aplikasi Screening & Shortlist
items.body:
Aplikasi Screening adalah proses review CV candidate & evaluate apakah mereka memenuhi minimum qualification untuk lanjut ke interview.

---

SCREENING CRITERIA:

Required Qualifications (must-have):
- Education level
- Years of experience
- Technical skills
- Language proficiency
- Availability/notice period

Nice-to-have (plus-plus):
- Advanced certifications
- Leadership experience
- Relevant industry
- Growth mindset

---

CARA SCREEN APLIKASI (HR):

1. Buka Recruitment → Applications
2. Filter by Job Posting: "Senior Developer (Java/Spring Boot)"
3. Status filter: "APPLIED" (newest applications)
4. List muncul: Candidate names, submission date, rating

5. Click candidate untuk review:
   
   Candidate Profile:
   - Name: "Budi Santoso"
   - Email: budi@example.com
   - Phone: +62-8xx-xxx
   - Uploaded files: CV (PDF), Cover Letter
   - Submission date: 20/04/2026

6. Review CV:
   - Education: S1 Informatics, Universitas Indonesia 2015
   - Experience:
     * PT XYZ (2015-2018): Junior Developer
     * PT ABC (2018-2022): Mid-level Developer
     * PT DEF (2022-Present): Senior Developer (2 years)
     * Total: ~9 years experience ✓ (requirement 5+ years)
   - Skills: Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, REST API ✓ (all required)
   - Languages: Indonesian, English ✓
   - Availability: 2 weeks notice ✓

7. Assessment:
   - Match Score: 90% (excellent fit)
   - Education: ✓ Bachelor degree
   - Experience: ✓ 9 years (exceed 5+ requirement)
   - Technical skills: ✓ All required
   - Nice-to-have: ✓ Docker, CI/CD mentioned
   - Red flags: None
   - Overall: PASS ✓ (qualified for interview)

8. Decision:
   - Rating: 5 stars (strong candidate)
   - Status: SHORTLIST ← Click to shortlist
   - Notes: "Excellent technical background. Senior level. Ready for interview."
   - Next: Invite for HR screening interview

---

APPLICATION STATUS WORKFLOW:

APPLIED → Review by HR
         ↓
      PASS SCREENING → Shortlisted (qualified for interview)
      FAIL SCREENING → Rejected (not qualified)

SHORTLISTED → HR interview scheduled
             ↓
           PASS HR INTERVIEW → Invite technical interview
           FAIL HR INTERVIEW → Rejected

TECHNICAL INTERVIEW → Pass/Fail
                    ↓
                  PASS → Invite final interview
                  FAIL → Rejected

FINAL INTERVIEW → Decision
               ↓
             APPROVED → Offer letter
             REJECTED → Thank you email

OFFER → Candidate decision
      ↓
    ACCEPTED → Onboarding
    REJECTED → Thank you email

---

EXAMPLE SCREENING BATCH:

Job: Senior Developer
Deadline: 30/05/2026
Total Applications: 42

Screening Results:
- 25 Qualified (59%) → Shortlist for interview
- 17 Not Qualified (41%) → Reject (missing requirements)

Rejection Reasons:
- 8: Not enough experience (< 5 years)
- 5: Missing required tech skills
- 3: Education not aligned
- 1: Salary expectation too high

Qualified Shortlist (25 candidates):
- Top tier (5-star): 5 candidates (strong match)
- Good tier (4-star): 12 candidates (good match)
- Acceptable tier (3-star): 8 candidates (acceptable match)

Next Step: Invite top 15 untuk HR screening (feasible interview load)

---

REJECTION EMAIL (Automated):

Subject: Application Status - [Job Title]

Dear [Candidate Name],

Thank you for applying to [Job Title] position at [Company]. We appreciate your interest.

After careful review of your application, we regret to inform you that your profile does not meet the minimum requirements for this role at this time. Specifically, the role requires [specific requirement] which is essential for success.

We encourage you to apply for other positions that may be a better fit for your background. Please check our careers page for open opportunities.

Best regards,
[Company HR Team]

---

SHORTLIST NOTIFICATION (Automated):

Subject: Great News! You're Invited to Interview

Dear [Candidate Name],

Congratulations! Your application for [Job Title] has impressed us. We'd like to invite you to the next stage of our recruitment process.

Please review the interview details:
- Type: HR Screening
- Date: [Date] [Time] (WIB)
- Duration: 45 minutes
- Interviewer: [HR Name]
- Format: Video call (link will be sent separately)
- Preparation: Please be ready to discuss your experience and career goals

Please confirm your availability by [Date]. If this time doesn't work, let us know and we'll find an alternative.

Looking forward to speaking with you!

Best regards,
[Company HR Team]

items.title: Interview Process (Multi-Round)
items.body:
Interview Process adalah serangkaian percakapan structured dengan candidate untuk assess technical skills, cultural fit, dan suitability untuk role.

---

INTERVIEW STAGES:

1. HR SCREENING INTERVIEW (30-45 min)
   - Conducted by: HR Recruiter
   - Purpose: Verify CV details, assess communication, cultural fit, motivation
   - Questions:
     * "Tell us about your background and experience"
     * "Why interested in this role/company?"
     * "What attracted you to our company?"
     * "What are your salary expectations?"
     * "When can you start?"
     * "Any questions for us?"
   - Outcome: PASS/FAIL
   - Decision criteria: Communication clear? Motivated? Realistic expectations?

2. TECHNICAL INTERVIEW (60-90 min)
   - Conducted by: Senior Developer / Tech Lead
   - Purpose: Assess technical depth, problem-solving, architecture knowledge
   - Format:
     * Discussion on past projects
     * Technical problem-solving (coding challenge or design discussion)
     * Architecture & system design questions
     * Code review discussion
   - Example questions:
     * "Describe a complex project you worked on. What was your role?"
     * "Design a scalable e-commerce system. What components?"
     * "Write code to solve [algorithm problem]"
     * "How would you optimize this slow query?"
   - Outcome: PASS/FAIL
   - Decision criteria: Technical depth adequate? Problem-solving good? Can learn?

3. FINAL INTERVIEW (30-45 min)
   - Conducted by: Department Manager / Director
   - Purpose: Assess leadership potential, team fit, company alignment
   - Topics:
     * Role expectations & responsibilities
     * Team dynamics & working style
     * Career development plans
     * Company vision & values fit
     * Compensation & benefits
   - Outcome: APPROVED/REJECTED (hiring decision)
   - Decision criteria: Right fit for team? Growth potential? Can contribute?

---

CARA SCHEDULE INTERVIEW (HR):

1. Buka Recruitment → Interviews
2. Klik + Schedule Interview
3. Isi:
   - Candidate: "Budi Santoso"
   - Job Posting: "Senior Developer (Java/Spring Boot)"
   - Interview Stage: HR Screening (1st round)
   - Interviewer: "Siti Nurhaliza" (HR Recruiter)
   - Date: 02/05/2026
   - Time: 10:00 WIB
   - Duration: 45 minutes
   - Format: Video call (Zoom) / In-person
   - Zoom link: [auto-generated]
4. Klik Send Invitation
5. Email sent to candidate with:
   - Confirmation of interview details
   - Zoom link (if virtual)
   - Preparation tips
   - What to expect
6. Candidate confirm attendance
7. Status: SCHEDULED

---

INTERVIEW FEEDBACK (Post-Interview):

After interview, interviewer submit feedback:

1. Buka Recruitment → Interviews → [Interview]
2. Click + Add Feedback
3. Isi:
   - Interviewer: "Siti Nurhaliza"
   - Rating: 1-5 stars
   - Technical Assessment: 4/5 (strong technical knowledge)
   - Communication: 4/5 (clear, articulate)
   - Cultural Fit: 5/5 (shares values)
   - Team Fit: 4/5 (collaborative approach)
   - Comments:
     "Budi demonstrated strong technical background. Very confident in Java & Spring Boot. Problem-solving approach systematic. Mild concern: spoke mostly technical, less emphasis on soft skills. Overall: Strong candidate, ready for final interview."
   - Overall Rating: 4/5 ✓ PASS
   - Recommendation: PASS (invite technical interview)

4. Klik Submit Feedback
5. Status: FEEDBACK_RECEIVED
6. HR review & schedule next round

---

MULTI-ROUND EXAMPLE:

Candidate: "Budi Santoso"
Applied: 20/04/2026

Round 1: HR Screening (02/05/2026, 10:00)
- Interviewer: Siti Nurhaliza (HR)
- Feedback: 4/5 PASS → "Good communication, motivated, realistic expectations"
- Decision: Invite technical interview

Round 2: Technical Interview (08/05/2026, 14:00)
- Interviewer: Ahmad Riyanto (Senior Dev)
- Feedback: 4/5 PASS → "Strong technical skills, good problem-solver, architecture knowledge solid"
- Decision: Invite final interview

Round 3: Final Interview (15/05/2026, 11:00)
- Interviewer: Andi Wijaya (Engineering Manager)
- Feedback: 5/5 PASS → "Excellent cultural fit, team player, growth potential, leadership capability"
- Decision: APPROVED → Make offer

Timeline: ~25 days from application to offer

---

REJECTION AT ANY STAGE:

If candidate fail at any round:

Round 2 Rejection (Technical Interview):
- Feedback: 2/5 FAIL → "Technical depth inadequate, struggled with design questions"
- Decision: REJECTED
- HR send rejection email:

  "Dear Budi,
   Thank you for your time in the technical interview. We appreciate your interest in the Senior Developer role. While we were impressed by your communication and experience, our technical team felt that your proficiency in system design and architecture needs further development for this senior role.
   
   We'd like to keep your profile for future mid-level or mentorship opportunities. Please feel free to reach out in 12 months as you develop these skills.
   
   Best regards,
   [Company HR]"

- Candidate status: REJECTED_TECH_INTERVIEW
- Keep candidate in talent pool (for future roles)

---

INTERVIEW BEST PRACTICES:

✓ Structured questions (same for all candidates, fair comparison)
✓ Multiple interviewers (reduce bias, diverse perspectives)
✓ Feedback documented (for decision justification)
✓ Timely feedback (schedule next round quick)
✓ Respectful process (even if rejecting)
✓ Clear next steps (what happens after)
✓ Flexibility (accommodate candidate schedule if possible)
✓ Professional environment (reflect company culture)

items.title: Offer Letter & Negotiation
items.body:
Offer Letter adalah dokumen formal yang diberikan kepada candidate terpilih, berisi posisi, kompensasi, benefit, dan kondisi employment.

---

OFFER LETTER COMPONENTS:

1. POSITION & ROLE
   - Job Title: Senior Developer (Java/Spring Boot)
   - Department: IT/Engineering
   - Reports To: Head of Engineering
   - Location: Jakarta, Indonesia
   - Employment Type: Full-time Permanent

2. COMPENSATION
   - Base Salary: Rp 17.000.000/month
   - Additional benefits:
     * Annual bonus: 2 months (paid in June & December)
     * Performance incentive: up to Rp 5.000.000 (based on KPI)
     * Health insurance: Fully covered (employee + family)
     * Life insurance: Rp 500.000.000 coverage

3. BENEFITS & ALLOWANCES
   - Allowances:
     * Transportation: Rp 1.000.000/month
     * Communication: Rp 500.000/month
     * Meals: Rp 500.000/month
   - Leave entitlement:
     * Annual leave: 12 days
     * Sick leave: Unlimited (with certificate)
     * Religious holidays: Granted per regulation
     * Maternity/Paternity: Per regulation

4. EMPLOYMENT CONDITIONS
   - Start Date: 01/06/2026
   - Probation Period: 3 months (01/06 - 31/08/2026)
   - Working Hours: Monday-Friday, 09:00-17:00 (8 hours/day)
   - Work Schedule: Standard office attendance
   - WFH: 2 days/week (after probation)
   - Overtime: Paid (time + 1.5x rate)

5. TERMS & CONDITIONS
   - Non-disclosure agreement (NDA) required
   - Confidentiality obligation
   - Intellectual property: Company owns (work product)
   - Notice period: 1 month (either party)
   - Early termination: Severance per regulation
   - Probation termination: 1-week notice (either party)

6. ACCEPTANCE
   - Candidate must sign & return within 5 days
   - If accepted: Send copy + ID + documentation
   - If rejected: Decline in writing

---

CARA CREATE OFFER LETTER (HR):

1. Buka Recruitment → Offers
2. Klik + Create Offer
3. Isi:
   - Candidate: "Budi Santoso"
   - Job Posting: "Senior Developer (Java/Spring Boot)"
   - Offer Date: 16/05/2026
   - Start Date: 01/06/2026
   - Probation Duration: 3 months
   - Employment Type: Permanent
   - Salary: 17.000.000 (base)
   - Additional Compensation:
     * Annual Bonus: 2 months
     * Performance Incentive: Up to Rp 5.000.000
   - Allowances: 2.000.000 total
   - Benefits: Health/Life insurance
   - Terms: NDA, Confidentiality, IP clause
   - Approval: Andi Wijaya (Manager)
   - HR approval: Siti Nurhaliza (HR)

4. System generate offer letter (template-based)
5. Review document
6. Klik Send Offer
7. Email to candidate:
   - Offer letter PDF attached
   - Congratulations message
   - Instructions to sign & return within 5 days
   - Q&A contact: HR phone/email
   - Welcome message

---

CANDIDATE RESPONSE OPTIONS:

1. ACCEPT OFFER
   - Candidate download offer letter
   - Sign (digital or print + scan)
   - Return to HR within 5 days
   - Status: ACCEPTED
   - HR initiate onboarding process
   - Finance setup payroll

2. NEGOTIATE
   - Candidate request discussion (email/call)
   - Negotiation points:
     * Salary: "Can we discuss Rp 18M instead of 17M?"
     * Start date: "Can I start 15/06 instead of 01/06?"
     * WFH: "Can I WFH 3 days/week from day 1?"
     * Relocation: "Can company assist relocation from Surabaya?"
   - HR discuss with Manager
   - If acceptable: Revise offer letter
   - Send updated offer
   - Candidate accept/reject revised offer

3. REJECT OFFER
   - Candidate politely decline
   - Reason (optional): "Accepted position elsewhere", "Personal reasons", etc
   - HR thank you & keep in talent pool
   - Status: REJECTED
   - Move to next candidate (if available)

---

EXAMPLE NEGOTIATION:

Original Offer: Rp 17.000.000/month
Candidate Request: Rp 18.000.000/month
Reason: "Higher than my current at PT XYZ (Rp 18.5M)"

HR Discussion with Manager (Andi):
- "Budi wants Rp 18M. Original budget Rp 17M."
- Manager: "He's strong candidate. Rp 1M difference manageable. Approve Rp 17.5M compromise."

Revised Offer: Rp 17.500.000/month
- Split difference
- Candidate accept ← Good compromise

---

OFFER MANAGEMENT BEST PRACTICES:

✓ Clear terms (no ambiguity)
✓ Competitive salary (attract talent, retain)
✓ Comprehensive benefits (health, insurance, leave)
✓ Flexible terms (if possible, negotiate)
✓ Quick turnaround (send offer within 1 week of final interview)
✓ Professional presentation (formal, clear)
✓ Legal review (comply regulation)
✓ Document management (archive for compliance)

items.title: Onboarding & Employee Record Creation
items.body:
Onboarding adalah proses formal untuk welcome new employee & integrate mereka ke company, plus setup employee record di system.

---

ONBOARDING OBJECTIVES:

1. Welcome & motivation
   - Make new hire feel welcome & excited
   - Set positive tone
   - Reduce first-day anxiety

2. Role clarity
   - Explain role responsibilities
   - Introduce team members
   - Set expectations & success metrics

3. System setup
   - Create employee record
   - Setup payroll
   - IT access (email, systems)
   - Office setup (desk, equipment)

4. Culture integration
   - Share company vision, values
   - Introduce processes & policies
   - Compliance training
   - Meet colleagues

5. Quick productivity
   - Training on role-specific tasks
   - Mentoring assignment
   - First 30-day plan
   - Regular check-ins

---

ONBOARDING TIMELINE:

Before Start Date (1-2 weeks):

1. HR activities:
   - Send welcome email with logistics
   - Prepare office (desk, furniture, equipment)
   - Setup IT (email, laptop, access cards)
   - Prepare training materials
   - Assign mentor/buddy

2. Payroll setup:
   - Create payroll record
   - Setup bank account for salary transfer
   - Calculate benefits & allowances
   - Insurance enrollment

3. Manager activities:
   - Prepare team
   - Setup desk & equipment
   - Create onboarding checklist
   - Plan first week schedule

Example email to new hire:

"Dear Budi,

Welcome to [Company]! We're excited to have you join us as Senior Developer starting 01/06/2026.

Here's what to expect on your first day:

09:00 - Arrival at office (HR welcome, coffee, settle in)
09:30 - Orientation by HR (office tour, policies, benefits)
11:00 - Meet manager "Andi Wijaya"
11:30 - Team introduction & lunch with team
14:00 - IT setup (laptop, email, access)
15:00 - First training session (company overview)
16:30 - Wrap-up, Q&A
17:00 - End of day 1

What to bring:
- Original ID
- Tax documents (NPWP, KTP)
- Bank account info (for salary transfer)
- Vaccination certificate (if applicable)

Pre-arrival checklist:
- Review offer letter & terms
- Check office address & parking info
- Plan your commute
- Prepare any questions

We'll provide:
- Welcome pack (merchandise, manual)
- Welcome lunch (team gathering)
- Training materials
- Mentor/buddy for 30 days

Looking forward to meeting you!

Best regards,
[HR Name]
[Company]"

---

Day 1 ONBOARDING:

09:00 - Arrival
- HR meet at reception
- Welcome, coffee, settle in
- Desk tour
- Assign locker/parking

09:30 - HR Orientation (30 min)
- Company overview (vision, values)
- Organizational structure
- Key policies (attendance, dress code, conduct)
- Benefits explanation (insurance, leave)
- Payroll process & schedule
- Questions?

10:00 - Office Tour (20 min)
- Show facilities (restroom, cafeteria, parking)
- Health & safety briefing
- Emergency procedures

10:20 - Manager Meet (30 min)
- Welcome by Andi (manager)
- Role expectations
- Team overview
- First week plan
- Q&A

10:50 - Team Lunch (60 min)
- Lunch with team members
- Informal introductions
- Get to know colleagues
- Casual conversation

12:00 - System Setup (60 min)
- IT support
- Laptop setup
- Email account
- Access cards, badges
- Password setup
- VPN access

13:00 - Lunch break (60 min)
- Solo or with team

14:00 - First Training (60 min)
- HR conducts
- Document system tour
- Leave request process
- Attendance system
- Payslip access
- System navigation

15:00 - Role Training (60 min)
- Manager or mentor
- Technical setup (dev environment)
- Codebase overview
- Key projects
- Tools & access

16:00 - Wrap-up (30 min)
- Manager: "How's your first day?"
- Logistics for day 2
- What to expect tomorrow
- Final Q&A

16:30 - End of day

---

CARA CREATE EMPLOYEE RECORD (HR):

After offer accepted, HR create employee record in system:

1. Buka Employee → + New Employee
2. Isi:
   
   Personal Info:
   - First Name: Budi
   - Last Name: Santoso
   - Date of Birth: 15/01/1990
   - Gender: Male
   - Nationality: Indonesian
   - Religion: Islam
   - Marital Status: Married
   - Phone: +62-8xx-xxx
   - Email: budi@company.com
   - Address: [residential address]
   
   Identification:
   - ID Type: KTP (Indonesia ID)
   - ID Number: [KTP number]
   - ID Expiry: [date]
   - Tax ID (NPWP): [number]
   
   Employment Details:
   - Employee ID: EMP-2026-0123 (auto-generated)
   - Job Title: Senior Developer
   - Department: IT/Engineering
   - Manager: Andi Wijaya
   - Employment Type: Permanent
   - Join Date: 01/06/2026
   - Status: ACTIVE
   - Work Schedule: Fixed (Monday-Friday, 09:00-17:00)
   - Location: Jakarta
   
   Compensation:
   - Base Salary: Rp 17.500.000
   - Allowances:
     * Transportation: Rp 1.000.000
     * Communication: Rp 500.000
     * Meals: Rp 500.000
   - Annual Bonus: 2 months
   - Performance Incentive: Up to Rp 5.000.000
   
   Benefits:
   - Health Insurance: Company-paid
   - Life Insurance: Rp 500.000.000
   - Leave Entitlement: 12 days/year
   
   Banking:
   - Bank Name: BCA
   - Account Holder: Budi Santoso
   - Account Number: [xxxx xxxx xxxx]
   - Account Type: Savings

3. Attach documents:
   - KTP photocopy
   - NPWP photocopy
   - Education certificate
   - Previous employment letter

4. Klik Save
5. Status: ACTIVE (employee now in system)
6. Finance notified → setup payroll
7. IT notified → create email & access
8. Manager notified → prepare onboarding

---

FIRST 30 DAYS PLAN:

Day 1: Arrival & System Setup
Week 1: Role orientation, team integration, basic training
Week 2: Deep-dive into projects, mentor assignment
Week 3: First real task assignment
Week 4: Performance review (check-in) - how's it going?

Day 30 Checklist:
✓ Complete onboarding
✓ Familiar with role & team
✓ Self-service for systems (email, leave, payroll)
✓ First assignment completed
✓ Manager confidence: ready to work independently
✓ Feel welcome & connected to team

---

ONBOARDING BEST PRACTICES:

✓ Personal welcome (not just system setup)
✓ Clear role & expectations (avoid confusion)
✓ System access prepared (no delays)
✓ Mentor assigned (for support)
✓ Regular check-ins (week 1, 2, 4, 8)

items.title: Skenario 2: Rejection at Technical Interview
items.body:
Candidate "Citra Wijaya" interviews for Junior Developer role. Fails at technical interview.

Background:
- Applied: 15/04/2026
- HR screening passed: 20/04 ✓
- Technical interview: 27/04

Technical Interview Process:

1. Interviewer: Ahmad Riyanto (Senior Developer)
2. Duration: 90 minutes
3. Format: Video call
4. Topics:
   - Project experience discussion
   - Coding challenge (write code for binary search)
   - Database optimization question
   - System design (simple)

Interview Flow:

1. Introduction (5 min)
   - "Hi Citra, thanks for joining"
   - "We'll discuss your experience & do some technical problem-solving"
   - "Take your time. Questions at end."

2. Project Discussion (20 min)
   - "Tell us about your last project"
   - Citra: "I worked on e-commerce website at bootcamp. Built frontend with React."
   - Ahmad: "What's the backend architecture?"
   - Citra: "Umm, it was using Node.js I think... not sure."
   - Red flag: Vague about backend, didn't fully understand stack

3. Coding Challenge (30 min)
   - Task: "Write code for binary search in Java"
   - Time: 20 minutes
   - Citra:
     * Attempts to write code
     * Syntax errors
     * Logic mistake (boundary condition wrong)
     * Doesn't test or debug
     * Gives up after 15 min
   - Ahmad: "Let's review your code..."
     * Points out syntax errors
     * Explains correct approach
     * Citra: "Oh I see. I haven't coded in Java much."
   - Red flag: Fundamental coding gaps, can't implement basic algorithms

4. Database Question (20 min)
   - Q: "You have a slow query. How would you optimize?"
   - Citra: "Umm... add index?"
   - Ahmad: "Ok, which column would you index?"
   - Citra: "Not sure. Maybe the primary key?"
   - Ahmad: "Already indexed automatically. Let me explain..."
   - Red flag: Lacks database optimization knowledge

5. System Design (10 min)
   - Q: "Design a simple todo app. What components?"
   - Citra: "Frontend... backend... database?"
   - Ahmad: "Yes, and more specific?"
   - Citra: "Not sure..."
   - Red flag: Doesn't think architecturally

6. Questions (5 min)
   - "Any questions for me?"
   - Citra: "No, I think I'm good."

Feedback Submitted by Ahmad:

- Overall Rating: 2/5 FAIL ✗
- Technical Knowledge: 2/5 (very basic, lacks depth)
- Problem-solving: 2/5 (struggled with simple challenges)
- Communication: 3/5 (understood questions but couldn't explain well)
- Learning Ability: 3/5 (receptive to feedback, but starting point low)

Comments:
"Citra has basic programming knowledge but significant gaps for junior developer role. 
Specific concerns:

1. Java proficiency very limited. Haven't coded in Java, mainly Python/JavaScript.
2. Coding fundamentals weak. Struggled with basic algorithm (binary search).
3. Database knowledge minimal. Not familiar with indexing basics.
4. System design thinking absent. Can't break down simple problems.
5. Project understanding shallow. Didn't fully grasp backend architecture.

Positive:
- Willing to learn
- Polite & professional
- Shows up prepared

Recommendation: NOT READY for junior developer role. Suggest:
- 3-6 months additional learning (algorithms, data structures, SQL)
- Practice coding challenges (LeetCode, HackerRank)
- Take Java bootcamp or online course
- Reapply in 6 months when skills stronger"

Decision: REJECTED_TECHNICAL_INTERVIEW

---

Rejection Email from HR:

Subject: Technical Interview Feedback - Junior Developer Position

Dear Citra,

Thank you for participating in our technical interview for the Junior Developer position on April 27, 2026. We appreciate the time you invested in our recruitment process.

After careful evaluation, our technical team has determined that your current skill level requires further development before you'd be ready for this role. Specifically:

1. Java programming proficiency needs strengthening (syntax, best practices)
2. Fundamental algorithms (searching, sorting) require more practice
3. Database concepts (indexing, query optimization) need deeper understanding
4. System architecture thinking would benefit from structured learning

We recognize your potential and willingness to learn. We'd like to provide some recommendations for your development:

1. Complete a structured Java bootcamp or online course (3-6 months)
2. Practice coding challenges on platforms like LeetCode/HackerRank (consistent, daily practice)
3. Study data structures & algorithms (essential for interviews)
4. Build projects using Java (apply knowledge practically)
5. Contribute to open-source (real-world experience)

We encourage you to invest in these areas and reapply in 6-12 months when you've strengthened your fundamentals. At that time, you'll be much better positioned for junior developer roles.

Please feel free to reach out if you have questions about the feedback or would like recommendations for learning resources.

Best regards,
Siti Nurhaliza
HR Recruiter
[Company]

---

Candidate Response:

Citra receives email & feels disappointed. She's honest about herself: "I rushed through bootcamp. Didn't spend enough time on fundamentals."

Actions taken:
- Enrolled in Udemy Java course (3 months)
- LeetCode daily practice (1-2 hours)
- Build personal project (Java API)
- Document progress

Six months later (October 2026):

Citra reapply to company:
- Resume updated with:
  * Java certification
  * 50+ LeetCode problems solved
  * Personal project portfolio
- New HR screening
- New technical interview: 4/5 PASS ✓
  * Much improved
  * Solid Java knowledge
  * Problem-solving better
  * Interview feedback: "Great improvement. Strong candidate now."
- Final interview: Passed
- OFFERED & ACCEPTED ✓

---

KEY LESSONS:

✓ Early rejection != permanent rejection. Improvement possible.
✓ Feedback constructive, not punitive. Help candidate grow.
✓ Clear recommendation for development. Show path forward.
✓ Keep in talent pool. Company value continuous learners.
✓ Document reason. Fairness & transparency.
✓ Follow-up possible. Willing to re-evaluate after improvement.

Citra now successful Junior Developer, grateful for feedback that motivated improvement.

items.title: Pertanyaan Umum
items.body:
Q: Bagaimana menggunakan employee referral untuk recruitment?
A: Setup referral program: employee refer candidate, if hired dapat bonus (Rp 2-5 juta). Referral tracked di system, bonus triggered upon hire & probation completion. Best source: employee networks share company values.

Q: Apakah background check required?
A: Yes, untuk security & compliance. HR conduct background check setelah offer accepted (verify education, employment history, criminal record if applicable). Result must be clear before onboarding.

Q: Berapa lama probation period?
A: Typical 3 months (90 hari). During probation: either party dapat terminate dengan 1 week notice (flexible). After probation: formal notice period 1 month. Use probation for assessment: competent? Cultural fit? Ready to continue?

Q: Bagaimana jika candidate fail background check?
A: Conditional offer becomes void. HR inform candidate professionally: "We appreciate your interest, but background check revealed concerns. Unfortunately, offer rescinded." Keep confidential. Document reason (compliance).

Q: Bisa kah multiple job positions dijadikan satu recruitment cycle?
A: Yes. Create multiple job postings, manage applications together, shortlist per position. Economies of scale (shared interviews, combined events). But assess needs separately.

Q: Bagaimana untuk internal transfers/promotions?
A: Different process (faster). Existing employee apply internal, manager discuss readiness, assess against internal standards. If approved: no interview needed, direct assignment. If rejected: discuss development plan.

Q: Apakah gaji negotiation biasa?
A: Yes, normal. Set salary range in offer (flexibility). Allow 10-15% negotiation room. Factors: seniority, experience, market rate, budget. Document final agreed amount.

items.title: Best Practices
items.body:
1. Job Description CLEAR & COMPELLING
   - Title specific ("Senior Developer Java" not "Software Engineer")
   - Responsibilities concrete (5-7 bullets)
   - Qualification realistic (don't over-ask)
   - Salary transparent (range or negotiable)
   - Show culture & values

2. Screening STRUCTURED
   - Use rubric (consistent evaluation)
   - Multiple reviewers (reduce bias)
   - Document decision (fairness)
   - Quick turnaround (keep momentum)

3. Interview PROFESSIONAL
   - Structured questions (same for all, comparable)
   - Multiple perspectives (different interviewers)
   - Feedback documented (decision basis)
   - Respectful (even if rejecting)

4. Offer CLEAR
   - All terms explicit (salary, benefits, conditions)
   - Legal review (compliance)
   - Timely delivery (quick move)
   - Flexible negotiation (competitive)

5. Onboarding COMPREHENSIVE
   - Personal touch (not just system)
   - Role clarity (avoid confusion)
   - System ready (no delays)
   - Mentor assigned (support)
   - Regular check-in (week 1,2,4,8)

6. Communication TRANSPARENT
   - Keep candidate informed (at each stage)
   - Clear timeline (expectations)
   - Honest feedback (constructive)
   - Professional tone (represent company)

7. Compliance DOCUMENTED
   - Background check (security)
   - Offer acceptance (legal)
   - Employment contract (clarity)
   - Onboarding proof (audit)
   - Data privacy (GDPR, local)

8. Diversity & INCLUSION
   - Remove bias from job posting
   - Diverse interview panel
   - Inclusive hiring process
   - Equal opportunity (fair assessment)
   - Track diversity metrics

Modul Recruitment terintegrasi dengan beberapa modul lain:

1. Integrasi dengan Employee
Setelah offer accepted & onboarding complete, new hire record di-create di Employee module dengan data lengkap (personal, compensation, benefits). Seamless transition dari recruitment to employee master.

2. Integrasi dengan Payroll
Compensation offer (salary, allowances, benefits) dari Recruitment langsung di-input ke Payroll untuk payment processing. Finance access recruitment offer untuk verify & setup payroll account.

3. Integrasi dengan Work Schedule
Job posting specify work schedule type. Upon hire, new employee assign ke appropriate work schedule (fixed, flexible, night shift, etc). Attendance tracking begin from day 1.

4. Integrasi dengan Organization Structure
Job posting structured berdasarkan organization (department, level, reporting line). Recruitment aligned dengan org structure untuk maintain consistency.

5. Integrasi dengan Learning & Development
New hire onboarding dapat include L&D enrollment (training courses, mentoring). Development plan begin from day 1 to accelerate productivity & growth.
